001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.jbosslogging;
002
003import java.util.ArrayDeque;
004import java.util.Collections;
005import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
006import java.util.Map;
007
008import org.jboss.logging.Logger;
009import org.jboss.logging.LoggerProvider;
010import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
011
012import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
013
014/**
015 * Native {@link LoggerProvider} for JBoss Logging backed directly by
016 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter#global()}, not through SLF4J.
017 * <p>
018 * MDC/NDC storage below is ported from upstream's own
019 * {@code org.jboss.logging.AbstractLoggerProvider}/{@code AbstractMdcLoggerProvider}
020 * (same behavior, including {@code getNdc()}'s space-joined merged form) since both are
021 * package-private and cannot be extended from outside {@code org.jboss.logging}. MDC
022 * values are stringified on put (mirroring {@code Slf4jLoggerProvider}'s own
023 * {@code MDC.put(key, String.valueOf(value))}) so they can be surfaced directly as
024 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues} without a second conversion step.
025 */
026@ServiceProvider(LoggerProvider.class)
027public final class RainbowGumJBossLoggerProvider implements LoggerProvider {
028
029        private final ThreadLocal<Map<String, String>> mdcMap = new ThreadLocal<>();
030
031        private final ThreadLocal<ArrayDeque<NdcEntry>> ndcStack = new ThreadLocal<>();
032
033        /**
034         * For {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}.
035         */
036        public RainbowGumJBossLoggerProvider() {
037        }
038
039        @Override
040        public Logger getLogger(String name) {
041                return new RainbowGumJBossLogger(name, this);
042        }
043
044        /**
045         * The current thread's MDC, already string-valued, ready to become
046         * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues}.
047         * @return possibly empty, never <code>null</code>.
048         */
049        Map<String, String> mdcSnapshot() {
050                var map = mdcMap.get();
051                return map == null || map.isEmpty() ? Collections.emptyMap() : map;
052        }
053
054        @Override
055        public void clearMdc() {
056                var map = mdcMap.get();
057                if (map != null) {
058                        map.clear();
059                }
060        }
061
062        @Override
063        public @Nullable Object getMdc(String key) {
064                var map = mdcMap.get();
065                return map == null ? null : map.get(key);
066        }
067
068        @Override
069        public Map<String, Object> getMdcMap() {
070                var map = mdcMap.get();
071                return map == null ? Collections.emptyMap() : new LinkedHashMap<>(map);
072        }
073
074        @Override
075        public @Nullable Object putMdc(String key, @Nullable Object value) {
076                var map = mdcMap.get();
077                if (map == null) {
078                        map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
079                        mdcMap.set(map);
080                }
081                if (value == null) {
082                        return map.remove(key);
083                }
084                return map.put(key, String.valueOf(value));
085        }
086
087        @Override
088        public void removeMdc(String key) {
089                var map = mdcMap.get();
090                if (map != null) {
091                        map.remove(key);
092                }
093        }
094
095        @Override
096        public void clearNdc() {
097                var stack = ndcStack.get();
098                if (stack != null) {
099                        stack.clear();
100                }
101        }
102
103        @Override
104        public @Nullable String getNdc() {
105                var stack = ndcStack.get();
106                return stack == null || stack.isEmpty() ? null : stack.peek().merged;
107        }
108
109        @Override
110        public int getNdcDepth() {
111                var stack = ndcStack.get();
112                return stack == null ? 0 : stack.size();
113        }
114
115        @Override
116        public String peekNdc() {
117                var stack = ndcStack.get();
118                return stack == null || stack.isEmpty() ? "" : stack.peek().current;
119        }
120
121        @Override
122        public String popNdc() {
123                var stack = ndcStack.get();
124                return stack == null || stack.isEmpty() ? "" : stack.pop().current;
125        }
126
127        @Override
128        public void pushNdc(String message) {
129                var stack = ndcStack.get();
130                if (stack == null) {
131                        stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
132                        ndcStack.set(stack);
133                }
134                stack.push(stack.isEmpty() ? new NdcEntry(message) : new NdcEntry(stack.peek(), message));
135        }
136
137        @Override
138        public void setNdcMaxDepth(int maxDepth) {
139                var stack = ndcStack.get();
140                if (stack != null) {
141                        while (stack.size() > maxDepth) {
142                                stack.pop();
143                        }
144                }
145        }
146
147        private static final class NdcEntry {
148
149                private final String merged;
150
151                private final String current;
152
153                NdcEntry(String current) {
154                        this.merged = current;
155                        this.current = current;
156                }
157
158                NdcEntry(NdcEntry parent, String current) {
159                        this.merged = parent.merged + ' ' + current;
160                        this.current = current;
161                }
162
163        }
164
165}
